scenes.question: What does a workflow launcher do, and which conditions does it define?
scenes.heading: A launcher starts a workflow automatically on matching repository events and defines the event type, node type, path, and model

scenes.heading: Quick recap
items: Workflow models and launchers are configuration, and that configuration lives under /conf
Custom workflow models are stored under /conf/global/settings/workflow/models
Never place custom workflow models in /libs because /apps and /libs are immutable
They are deployed as code through the Cloud Manager pipeline as part of the project packages
The runtime model is generated under /var/workflow/models when the model is synced
A launcher starts a workflow automatically on matching repository events and defines the event type, node type, path, and model
